# Dictionary.com

> > Dictionary.com is a leading online dictionary and language resource offering word definitions, thesaurus services, educational content, and free online games including Sudoku, Solitaire, and word puzzles.

Dictionary.com provides comprehensive language tools and lexicography resources alongside a collection of daily games and puzzles. The platform serves both English and Spanish-speaking audiences with mobile apps for Android and iPhone, customer support resources, and seasonal gaming content.

## Key Topics

- Dictionary.com
- Lexicography
- Word of the Day
- Mobile Apps (Android, iPhone)
- Daily Games
- Sudoku
- Solitaire
- Crossword Puzzles
- Jigsaw Puzzles
- Mahjong
- Arkadium Games
- Customer Support
- Spanish Language Content
- Free Online Games

## Help & Support

- [Dictionary.com Help Center](https://help.dictionary.com/): Help center for Dictionary.com & Thesaurus.com with FAQs and support

## Optional

- [Juegos Diarios en línea gratis | De Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/es/categoría/diario): Daily games category in Spanish: Sudoku, Solitaire, Jigsaw puzzles
- [Por temporadas en línea gratis | De Dictionary.com](https://play.dictionary.com/es/categoría/por-temporadas): Seasonal games category in Spanish: Mahjong, Crystal Collapse
